verdict.rationale: Airbyte ships a built-in AI Assistant, but only inside the Connector Builder, where it automatically prefills and configures connector fields and sections. That lets users delegate connector setup work, but the evidence shows no general-purpose assistant for delegating tasks across the product. The MCP and Airbyte Agents material covers external agents connecting to Airbyte, not an assistant inside the product, so it is not credited here. Missing for 10: an assistant beyond Connector Builder (e.g. for connections, syncs, troubleshooting), documented multi-step task delegation, independent or hands-on corroboration of the AI Assistant.
